narrative: An architect from Damascus was born in Syria to a father who had come from Palestine in 1948 at the age of one. Because he was considered Palestinian Syrian he was never given citizenship, only refugee papers, and so described himself as a refugee from being a refugee. He left Syria in 2012 for Istanbul, but as a refugee he would never be given a work permit there and faced living the life of an undocumented immigrant providing cheap labor. In the summer of 2015 his brother's family and other friends joined him for the trip from Istanbul to Izmir, then by rubber dinghy to Lesbos, and through the Balkans to Germany. His sister was based in Spain, and because Spain has a family-friendly refugee policy she would be able to bring their parents to Spain legally.
